title: jarava humilis
intro: Jarava humilis, commonly known as Queñua or Queñua Blanca, is a plant species native to the Andean region of South America, belonging to the family Poaceae. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and gastrointestinal issues, due to its rich content of bioactive compounds. The Queñua plant is rich in flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Jarava humilis also include cardiovascular and immunomodulatory effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as queñuine and isorhapontigenin.
